# Real-photo fixtures

Pinned source: [scikit-image v0.21.0 data directory](https://github.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/tree/v0.21.0/skimage/data).
Attribution and license descriptions are recorded in its [data loader source](https://github.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/blob/v0.21.0/skimage/data/_fetchers.py).

| File            | Attribution                          | License noted upstream |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------ | ---------------------- |
| `astronaut.png` | NASA photograph of Eileen Collins    | Public domain          |
| `chelsea.png`   | Chelsea the cat, Stefan van der Walt | CC0                    |
| `rocket.jpg`    | SpaceX, DSCOVR/Falcon 9 launch       | Public domain          |

Used only in browser tests; never copied into the production app. Multiple-face
coverage duplicates a close crop of the astronaut photo in a composite; it is
not a real group photograph. Profile, glasses, varied lighting, real groups,
flowers and landscape photography remain unverified.
